QuestInfo.name: That Was Truly Wretched
QuestInfo.0: Vicky is very nervous about the audition. Talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Vicky is too busy preparing for the preliminary round of auditions, so she can't help you with the Spirit of Rock. She says to ask Victor and then come back once you've obtained it. \r\n\r\n#rTip: You can complete this quest after completing the quest, [Finally, the Spirit of Rock!]

0.0: I guess I don't have a choice, do I? Alright, I'm going to go get ready.
0.1: Oh yeah, you said you're here to get the Spirit of Rock, right? Talk to Victor. He'll know.
0.2: I'd appreciate it if you'd eliminate the Spirit of Rock before I get back from the preliminaries.

yes.0: I need utter silence! I must be zen and save my vocal energy for my audition!
yes.1: Ask Victor about the Spirit of Rock and steal... I mean, uh, um, blargh!! Listen, just defeat it and then come see me!

no.0: Well, I guess you don't wanna see the Spirit of Rock after all, huh?

1.0: Are you here for the preliminaries?

yes.0: NOOOOOOOO!!!!! I failed the preliminary round!
yes.1: I can't believe I failed! Those judges were mean!
yes.2: I didn't even get the legendary guitar. Ugh, this is the worst!

npc.0: The auditions haven't even begun yet. Defeat the Spirit of Rock and then come back.
